title: Clinical trial <-> publication linkage from machine-checkable fields only

confirmed: (a) the trial record has a referencesModule reference naming a PMID with type in {RESULT, DERIVED} -> status CONFIRMED, scoped to the field-level claim that the trial record names that paper
(b) the paper's own abstract contains a literal NCT number AND that trial resolves in the ClinicalTrials.gov API v2 -> CONFIRMED
candidate: trial references a PMID as BACKGROUND (the trial mentions the paper)
trial references a PMID with no recognised reference type
rejected: a paper's abstract states an NCT number that does not resolve
rule.never_used_as_evidence: subject similarity, shared device name, shared sponsor, journal, or co-mention. No relation in this file rests on those.

caveat: ClinicalTrials.gov reference `type` is submitter-asserted and is observably wrong for some records in this sample (an epidemiology paper labelled RESULT for a venous-ulcer device trial). CONFIRMED therefore means 'the field says so', not 'the paper is about this trial'.
